Name: Cave Carrot Crop
Author: LavenderSkelly
Description:
Another piece of the big Mod that can be shared separately, I needed a Cave carrot as a crop and I needed it to be my own assets I made.

Cave Carrots take 8 days to grow inside and are for sale at Dwarf's shop.

[u]Mods showcased in Media[/u]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14916]Dwarf Portrait Replacement[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11762]Bigger farmhouse[/url]
